mapper.select: SELECT eo.id, eo.order_no AS orderNo, eo.user_id AS userId, u.username, eo.product_id AS productId, eo.product_name AS productName, eo.quantity, eo.points_required AS pointsRequired, eo.total_points AS totalPoints, eo.order_status AS orderStatus, eo.receiver_name AS receiverName, eo.receiver_phone AS receiverPhone, eo.receiver_address AS receiverAddress, eo.express_company AS expressCompany, eo.express_no AS expressNo, eo.remark, eo.create_time AS createTime, eo.update_time AS updateTime FROM exchange_order eo LEFT JOIN user u ON eo.user_id = u.id WHERE eo.id = #{id}
